EVERY STUDENT'S FULL MOVE LIST (keyboard P1 shown · A = J, B = K, Shield = L, Grab = U, Jump = Space)

Ground attacks

Jab / neutral attack
A (tap again for the combo)
Dash attack
A right after you start running
F-tilt / U-tilt / D-tilt
Hold ← → / ↑ / ↓ then A
F-smash / U-smash / D-smash
Direction + A together, hold A to charge

Aerial attacks

Nair
A in the air
Fair / Bair
Toward / away + A
Uair / Dair
↑ / ↓ + A
Zair (grab-air tether)
Grab in the air, or Shield + A. Reaches out with the student's quirk and can grab a ledge.

Special moves

Neutral B / Side B / Up B / Down B
B, ← → + B, ↑ + B, ↓ + B
Final Smash
Fill the meter under your name by dealing and taking damage. When it glows, press B (neutral) to unleash it.

Grabs and throws

Grab
Grab, or Shield + A
Pummel
A while holding
F / B / U / D-throw
Direction while holding

Defense and ledge

Shield
Hold Shield
Spot dodge
Shield + ↓
Forward / back roll
Shield + ← or →
Air dodge
Shield in the air (+ direction)
Tech / tech roll
Shield just before you land while launched (+ direction to roll)
Get-up attack / roll / stand
After a missed tech you lie down: A, ← →, or ↑ / Jump
Ledge get-up / roll / jump / attack
On a ledge: toward stage, Shield, Jump, or A
Parry
Let go of Shield just as an attack lands. You take no damage and the attacker is frozen for a moment.
DI (bend your launch)
Hold a direction while you are launched to steer the angle and survive longer
Rage
The more damage you carry, the harder your hits launch

Walk / dash
Hold a direction / flick it
Short hop / full hop
Tap / hold Jump
Double jump
Jump in the air (Emi, Zabu and Suze get a third)
Fast fall
↓ while falling
Crouch
Hold ↓
Platform drop
Flick ↓ on a platform
Wall jump
Press Jump while touching the stage's side wall
